statement: Comparison for U017: the differences from the closest works are largely implementation-level. MHGRN implements 'use the reasoning chain' architecturally (a multi-hop relation module over an extracted subgraph) with QA-label training, whereas the idea would supply chain text as supervision to a fine-tuned LLM; KnowTrace implements a self-training loop with process supervision over knowledge triplets, whereas the idea's repair loop only changes the selection signal (one-hop failures instead of contributive generations). Neither is a new mechanism; both are alternate implementations of established mechanisms.
